svg.title: A launch for every wind
svg.desc: An isolated plateau with a launch on each of its four sides, one for every wind direction, drawn as contours, with the flat country all round and a climb lifting off near the landing paddock rather than on the face of the hill. After Godfrey Wenness on Mount Borah. Schematic.
svg.text: the climb is often out here,
not on the face of the hill
